findings: F01 major: preferred structs=struct-typer indiscriminately denotes struct types; moretypes/4 Pointers to structs refers to struct values. Distinguish plural struct values from struct types, while keeping natural Bokmal usage.

F02 major: preferred slide=side is unqualified despite bare slides hyperlinks to talk presentations in concurrency/11, as opposed to Tour slides in welcome/1 and concurrency/1. Define context-specific handling of standalone slide/slides so presentation links read lysbilder and Tour pages read sider.
F03 minor: forbidden korutine is a valid Norwegian term for the separate concept coroutine; do not globally ban it merely to reject mistranslation of goroutine.
F04 minor: keep API has no occurrence in the 122 reviewed source units or 113 English UI messages; remove it unless there is a current unprotected translatable source use.
